svg.title: A table of values closing in on x = 2
svg.desc: Left: the graph of f(x) = (square root of (x + 2) minus 2) divided by (x - 2), a slowly falling curve with an open circle at (2, 0.25). A blue box marks the region near x = 2. Right: that region zoomed in, with blue dots at x = 1.9, 1.99, 2.01 and 2.1 sitting on the curve on both sides of the open circle at height 0.25. Below, a table: x = 1.9, 1.99, 1.999 give f(x) = 0.251582, 0.250156, 0.250016; x = 2 is undefined; x = 2.001, 2.01, 2.1 give 0.249984, 0.249844, 0.248457. Both sides close in on 0.25.
